social_circle.name: Denise Terry

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences with affectionate check-ins, prayer language, and practical reminders. Calls when something feels important or when she hears stress in Kennedi's voice.

recent_text_topics: Checking in on Kennedi's blood pressure routine, walking, and whether she is resting after work stress.
Coordinating Denise's diabetes and arthritis appointments, portal messages, and medication questions.
Planning Sunday dinner, family birthdays, church events, and who is bringing what food.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Kennedi's parents Robert and Denise are very important, live nearby, and she talks to her mother by phone almost every other day. Q35 says Kennedi helps her parents with portals, appointments, and medication questions. Q46 says her mother and Tasha can hear when something is off.
